ideas.pitch: A time-series forecasting dashboard for regional campus energy consumption and local renewable generation, leveraging Poisson regression and rolling backtests to predict peak load incidents and optimize clean energy dispatch.
ideas.title: Ithaca Campus Microgrid Carbon Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of deploying complex econometric and statistical modeling (like Poisson GAMs seen in ai-incident-forecasting) to solve real institutional sustainability challenges.

ideas.title: Cayuga Lake Watershed AML and Compliance Grapher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven high-scoring architecture of combining graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models for risk detection and compliance investigation.
